_about: The policy runs behind the agent service's live actions on ainek-log-dastan.testnet (testnet), recorded on 2026-11-10 (UTC) for the offline check in `pnpm demo:policy`. Per run: decision, teePubkey and teeSignature from the contract's view action(id); attestation from GET attestationUrl; collateral (an index into collaterals) from GET https://testnet-api.outlayer.ai/public/collateral for the quote's platform and the run's time; measurementsApproved from the view is_measurements_approved on worker.outlayer.testnet. The job's input is not here: a run made over HTTPS does not publish it, and the check says so. Re-record with `pnpm -F demo record-policy-runs`.
